$ grok -p <prompt>
--- prompt ---
You are competing in AgentpitBench against three other AI agents.
Goal: win. Pick the outcome of this prediction market most likely to pay off.
You have 5 minutes and exactly one bet of 100 tokens.

Market: Will BV Borussia 09 Dortmund win on 2026-10-09?
Outcomes: Yes / No | prices: Yes 0.715, No 0.285 | closes: 2026-10-09T18:30:00Z

Use `bench --help` to inspect the market. You may research online.
The clock is hard: no bet placed within the 5 minutes forfeits the round. `bench market` shows seconds_left.
Finish with: bench bet --outcome <label> --confidence <0-1> --rationale '<one or two sentences>'
Optional: add --quote '<one line of trash talk for your rivals>' (max 120 chars, no links or @mentions). It goes on your public card.
Use single quotes around --rationale and --quote so "$" amounts survive the shell.

This is your first round.

{"type":"thought","data":"Synthesizing the odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" carefully."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker implied "}
{"type":"thought","data":"probabilities for the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Dortmund win are roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 70–71% across major"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sites. The market price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of 0.715 aligns closely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with this consensus."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nPinnacle and BetFTW"}
{"type":"thought","data":" both imply roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"70% for Dortmund. Betdecider"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows 73.7% raw moneyline,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but that figure includes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" vig and excludes the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" draw. DRatings was "}
{"type":"thought","data":"updated just minutes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ago."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDRatings models a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"73.1% Dortmund win, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"implying roughly a 27%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of loss. CompactStats"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows a similar no-vig"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability near 71%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price sits"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.715."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBetFTW and CompactStats"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model a higher 76–78%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate, while talacote"}
{"type":"thought","data":" AI and Footyprofit "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sit at 61.2% and 60%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.715 is almost exactly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair to the sharper"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bookmaker consensus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" near 70–73%. The key"}
{"type":"thought","data":" question is which side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" actually has edge.\n\nThe instruction to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick the outcome most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely to pay off means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" selecting the side "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of resolving in our"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favor. This is about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"payoff likelihood, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" necessarily positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge relative to the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nChecking the payoff"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mechanics. Buying Yes"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.715 yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 140 shares for a 40"}
{"type":"thought","data":" token profit if it "}
{"type":"thought","data":"wins. Buying No at 0.285"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly 351 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"shares for a 251 token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit. Expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calculations are now"}
{"type":"thought","data":" being run against the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" implied probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show the market is nearly fair. At the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"current price, betting Yes yields roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"-0.7 tokens and No yields +1.75 tokens. The next step is to check how AgentpitBench scores rounds."}

{"type":"thought","data":" should equal the true"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"outcome. Setting it "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to 0.72 maximizes expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calibration accuracy."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nConfidence may scale"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the position size. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The agent with the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confidence on the correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side wins the most "}
{"type":"thought","data":"when right and loses"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the most when wrong."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Expected value depends"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on edge.\n\nWith four"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents, a correct pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ties all other correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" picks unless confidence"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or price differentiates"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit.\n\nThe default"}

{"type":"thought","data":" plus 0.05. At an ask"}

{"type":"thought","data":" could be 0.77."}

{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nI will set --max-price"}
